plan.chain_of_thought:
1. Scope & Dependencies Check: Plan contains exactly 7 files (within the ≤8 limit). Explicitly restricts to Python stdlib (json, dataclasses, typing, pathlib, importlib, sys, random, time, argparse). Zero paid or external APIs. Fully compliant.
2. Interface & Test Coverage Review: Interfaces are well-defined, but test instructions for the fuzzer generator needed hardening. Generators are single-pass and must be consumed into a list before asserting counts. Updated test_main.py instructions to explicitly convert the iterable to a list. Validator originally listed json.JSONDecodeError, which is irrelevant for dict payloads; replaced with broad Exception capture (explicitly excluding SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt) for robust fuzzing. CLI instructions lacked explicit argparse wiring; added __main__ guard specification to properly invoke run_audit.
3. Determinism & Safety Hardening: Fuzzer instructions updated to yield a fixed, predictable number of variants per strategy to guarantee exact test assertions. Validator timing uses time.perf_counter safely. File I/O guards retained for win32 safety. DI pattern strictly enforced across all modules.
4. Final Alignment: All constraints met. Instructions tightened for exact reproducibility, safe generator consumption, realistic exception handling, and complete CLI wiring. Output matches requested schema exactly.
plan.vision:
PROBLEM: Agent tool-parsers crash or silently corrupt state when encountering minor JSON schema deviations (missing keys, type drift, boundary values). Developers lack deterministic stress-testing for these contracts.
MILESTONES: (1) Schema Normalization: Parse raw JSON schema into a flat, validated internal spec. (2) Deterministic Fuzzing: Generate edge-case variants via seeded strategies (omit_required, inject_extra, type_mismatch, boundary_values, deep_truncate). (3) Safe Validation Harness: Execute user parser callables against variants, capturing exceptions and return states without pipeline crashes. (4) CLI Orchestration: Wire components, handle file I/O safely, output structured JSON reports.
TESTING STRATEGY: Pure unit tests importing actual modules. Define a real dummy_agent_parser function (no unittest.mock) that intentionally fails on specific mutations. Consume generator outputs into lists for deterministic assertions. Assert exact ValidationReport counts, exception types, and execution flows. Verify single-pass execution and DI wiring.
plan.interface_contracts:
normalizer.py -> normalize_schema(raw: dict) -> NormalizedSchema
fuzzer.py -> generate_variants(schema: NormalizedSchema, seed: int = 42) -> Iterable[FuzzVariant]
validator.py -> validate_variant(variant: FuzzVariant, parser_fn: Callable[[dict], Any]) -> ValidationReport
cli.py -> run_audit(schema_path: str, parser_module_path: str, parser_func_name: str) -> list[ValidationReport]
test_main.py -> Imports all above. Defines dummy_agent_parser(payload: dict) -> dict. Runs pipeline. Asserts exact dataclass fields, deterministic counts, and exception captures.
plan.lessons_learned: This project avoids past mistakes by: (1) Strictly decoupling core logic via Dependency Injection; the validator accepts a Callable parser_fn, enabling pure in-memory unit tests without unittest.mock. (2) Using a single-pass generator model in generate_variants that yields mutations sequentially, completely avoiding itertools.tee memory traps. (3) Hardening CLI file reads with explicit os.path.getsize guards before JSON loading to prevent win32 empty-file crashes. (4) Gracefully capturing all exceptions (broad Exception catch, explicitly re-raising SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt) inside the validator harness to ensure pipeline continuity on malformed payloads or crashing user parsers. (5) Relying exclusively on Python stdlib (json, dataclasses, typing, pathlib, importlib, sys, random, time, argparse) with zero heavy ML or external dependencies. (6) Returning strict dataclasses (NormalizedSchema, FuzzVariant, ValidationReport) for deterministic test assertions instead of fragile string parsing. (7) Pre-compiling validation rules and using seeded randomization to guarantee reproducible, cross-platform fuzzing sequences.
plan.commit_message: Implement deterministic tool-schema fuzzer and contract validation harness for autonomous agent parsers.

files_to_generate.instructions: Define dataclasses: NormalizedField(name, expected_type, required, nested_schema). Define NormalizedSchema(fields, raw). Implement pure function normalize_schema(raw: dict) -> NormalizedSchema. Recursively parse a simplified JSON schema dict (supports 'type', 'required', 'properties', 'items'). Validate structure explicitly; raise ValueError on malformed specs. Flatten nested objects into a deterministic traversal order. Use only stdlib typing/dataclasses. No I/O. Return strict NormalizedSchema.

Define dataclass FuzzVariant(payload, strategy, description). Implement pure generator generate_variants(schema: NormalizedSchema, seed: int = 42) -> Iterable[FuzzVariant]. Use random.Random(seed) for deterministic sequences. Implement 5 mutation strategies applied in a single-pass loop: omit_required (drop mandatory keys), inject_extra (add random keys), type_mismatch (swap str/int/bool/null), boundary_values (empty strings, huge ints, empty arrays), deep_truncate (cut nested dicts). Yield exactly 1 variant per strategy per top-level field to guarantee deterministic counts for testing. No itertools.tee. No external deps. Pure function accepting NormalizedSchema, yielding dataclasses.

Define dataclass ValidationReport(variant_strategy, success, exception_type, exception_msg, execution_time_ms). Implement pure function validate_variant(variant: FuzzVariant, parser_fn: Callable[[dict], Any]) -> ValidationReport. Wrap parser_fn execution in try/except. Catch Exception broadly to capture all parser failures, but explicitly re-raise SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt. Record exception type name and message gracefully. Measure execution time with time.perf_counter. Return ValidationReport. Strict DI: accepts any callable matching signature. No I/O. No mocks.

Implement run_audit(schema_path: str, parser_module_path: str, parser_func_name: str) -> list[ValidationReport]. Use pathlib for paths. Guard file reads with os.path.getsize check to prevent win32 empty-file crashes. Load JSON schema, call normalize_schema. Dynamically import user parser module via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, extract parser_func_name callable. Wire pipeline: iterate generate_variants, pass each to validate_variant with loaded callable. Collect reports. Print JSON-serialized report to stdout. Add if __name__ == '__main__': block with argparse to parse --schema, --parser-module, --parser-func and invoke run_audit. Catch and log file/module errors explicitly. Cross-platform safe. No heavy deps.

Import normalize_schema, generate_variants, validate_variant, NormalizedSchema, FuzzVariant, ValidationReport. Define a real function dummy_agent_parser(payload: dict) -> dict that explicitly raises TypeError on type_mismatch, KeyError on omit_required, and returns {'status':'ok'} otherwise. Test 1: normalize_schema with valid dict -> assert NormalizedSchema fields. Test 2: generate_variants with seed=42 -> immediately consume into list, assert deterministic count and strategy names. Test 3: validate_variant with dummy_agent_parser -> assert exact exception_type captures and success flags. Test 4: Full pipeline integration -> run generator through validator, collect reports, assert counts match expected mutation outcomes. NO unittest.mock. Pure assertions on dataclass fields. Must pass deterministically.
Standard Python gitignore. Include: __pycache__/, *.pyc, *.pyo, .venv/, venv/, env/, .env, *.egg-info/, dist/, build/, .mypy_cache/, .pytest_cache/, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db
